paving.description: Our collection features a diverse selection of natural stone landscaping products, including three distinct patio paving options. For a modern, sleek finish, the Premiastone range offers clean-cut edges and a variety of colours. If you prefer a traditional look, the Cragstone range provides weathered natural stone options, adding warmth and charm. For timeless appeal, Classicstone offers traditional flagstones, with single-size options for a modern feel or a project pack for a classic design.

natural-stone-paving.description: Talasey’s stone range, Natural Paving, offers a wide selection of natural stone landscaping products designed for gardens and driveways, each of which presents a choice of colour, finish and style, providing something to suit every project, home and budget.

porcelain-paving.description: With something to suit all styles and budgets, our range of Italian inspired porcelain paving provides homeowners with a contemporary, low maintenance, landscaping solution.

paving-installation.description: A successful paving project starts with the right installation materials. At Talasey, we offer a comprehensive range of paving installation products designed to help create durable, professional-quality outdoor spaces. From preparing the base to finishing the joints and edges, our solutions provide everything needed for a reliable and long-lasting installation.

composite-decking.description:
Constructed from a combination of FSC certified timber and recycled HDPE plastic, Piranha composite decking boasts the finest qualities and characteristics of both materials to deliver an outdoor installation that is practical, resilient, and an attractive addition to any garden.

With no rot, warps, or splits to worry about, composite decking offers a stress-free solution for busy households, while the concealed fixing system means there is no compromise where looks and aesthetics are concerned.

Browse our two decking ranges, Hunter and Terrafuzion, both of which come with a domestic warranty and offer a range of colours and finishes to suit any project, home, and budget.

pioneer-decking.description:
The next generation in composite decking – a premium, advanced solution that sets a new benchmark for beauty, strength, and sustainability in outdoor design.

As the UK’s first decking range to feature ultra-high-definition 4K woodgrain imaging, Pioneer captures the intricate textures and tones of three rare hardwoods with astonishing realism – Ipe, Jacaranda and Oak – all without cutting down a single tree.

Its PMMA aerospace-grade outer coating delivers unrivalled colour clarity and anti-fade technology, keeping decks looking vibrant and pristine even after years of sun exposure. Beneath the surface, Pioneer decking features a fibreglass-reinforced, FSC-certified bamboo mixed core for superior strength and stability, resisting warping and impact. Sustainably made with recycled plastics in solar-powered facilities, it’s the eco-friendly choice for luxury terraces, modern courtyards, and family gardens.

decking-installation.description: Discover Talasey’s complete range of decking installation accessories, including fixing screws, clips, and joist protection solutions. Designed to ensure secure, durable, and professional decking installations for both residential and commercial projects.

composite-gates.description: Enhance your outdoor space with Talasey’s composite gates, combining durability, low maintenance, and modern style. Designed to complement composite fencing and decking systems, they provide a secure, attractive, and long-lasting entrance solution.

composite-fencing.description:
Piranha’s fully capped composite fencing is available in three modern colours, each displaying an enhanced woodgrain finish on both sides, allowing the installation to not only enhance your property but also your neighbours!

Our slatted fencing provides a sleek, modern ‘slatted’ look, ideally suited to contemporary spaces. For those seeking a more traditional feel, consider our standard fencing range.

As with all Piranha products, the fencing is low-maintenance, durable against the elements and long-lasting. With optional trellis and decorative aluminium slats also available, you can create unique designs to enhance your landscape.

balustrades.description:
Enhance your outdoor space with a balustrade system that delivers the perfect balance of safety, style and durability. Whether you’re completing a deck, balcony, terrace or garden area, our range offers high-quality solutions to suit both traditional and contemporary homes.

From the classic appeal of composite balustrades to the sleek lines of glass and wire systems, every option is designed to provide long-lasting performance with minimal maintenance. With a choice of materials, styles and finishes, it’s easy to create a secure, attractive space that complements your home and maximises your outdoor living.

garden-edging.description: Our steel (powder coated and corten) and aluminium edging provides clean, crisp lines that frame every project beautifully. Offered in both standard sizes and made-to-measure options, it’s a straightforward way to achieve a professional finish.
garden-edging.closing: We offer fully bespoke edging, allowing you to choose the length, depth, thickness, and finish to suit your project. Whether you want sweeping curves, precise geometric layouts, or unique profiles, our edging can be made to match your vision perfectly.

walling-and-cladding.description:
To finish your hard landscaping with design and flair, look no further than the Natural Paving range of accessories.

Choose from natural stone walling, copings and firepits to really add those finishing touches to your project, available in a choice of complementary colours to suit any desired aesthetic.

stone-walling.description:
To finish your hard landscaping with design and flair, look no further than the Natural Paving range of accessories.

Choose from natural stone walling, copings and firepits to really add those finishing touches to your project, available in a choice of complementary colours to suit any desired aesthetic.

composite-cladding.description:
Piranha composite cladding offers homeowners and designers a unique way to style their outside living space.

Our Shadow Gap Cladding provides a sleek, modern ‘slatted’ look, ideally suited in contemporary spaces. For those who are after a more traditional feel, take a look at our Traditional Cladding range.

Available in a choice of three colours, both Piranha Cladding ranges present a natural woodgrain effect finish.

porcelain-cladding.description: Wall cladding offers a striking alternative to tiles and paint, adding a luxurious touch to any renovation project. With a wide range of colours and finishes available, our porcelain cladding will complement any style, enhancing both indoor and outdoor spaces. Whether you’re updating a patio, terrace bar, kitchen, or bathroom, our cladding provides the perfect finish for every project.

cleaners-and-sealers.description:
To keep your products looking spick and span all year round, you can rely on our comprehensive range of specialist cleaners.

The range boasts 15 different options and has been designed for general everyday use, through to removing specific stubborn stains.

Using the wrong cleaners can damage your investment!

Our range of sealants has been designed to delay the penetration of water and oily liquids, allowing time to clean up any spillage to prevent staining of the hard landscaped area.

With the added benefit of being breathable, not only can they be used to seal your paving before installation, but they can also be used immediately after.

All sealants can be used both internally and externally. We recommend using a paintbrush for internal products.

drainage.description:
The Pavetuf Decorative Channel Drainage offers a lightweight, durable and easy-to-install drainage system. Whether you need garden or patio drainage, our system offers a choice of colours, patterns and finishes, to enhance your paved area and landscape.

Pavetuf’s Channel Drain system is a perfect choice for both pedestrian and light vehicular traffic areas. The system is tested in accordance with EN 1433:2003 standard and meets A15 and B125 classes.

artificial-grass.description: Talasey’s Artificial Grass range, Luxigraze, is an established range of high-quality artificial grass products designed for beautiful, all-year-round, low-maintenance gardens.

pergolas.description: Our powder-coated aluminium pergolas create striking outdoor structures with options that suit both residential gardens and large-scale commercial projects. Available as modular kits in various sizes.
pergolas.closing:
We hope our range of pergolas has inspired you. If you have your own vision, we offer bespoke pergola design and build services to bring your ideas to life. Crafted in Britain using high-quality materials such as powder-coated steel, aluminium, or sustainably sourced timber, each pergola is made to suit your exact style and outdoor space.

Whether you’re looking to create a shaded retreat, an elegant garden feature, or a functional extension of your home, every design is uniquely yours, tailored to complement your surroundings and lifestyle.

fire-pits.description: Play with the elements and allow us to create a fire pit only for you, to suit your design. From classic off-the-shelf stone to custom-made designs with elegant metal surrounds, our fire pits offer the perfect way to transform your garden into a welcoming, all year round retreat.

outdoor-lighting.description:
Dellaora is Talasey’s 12V plug & play lighting system made for landscapers. Safe, smart, and seriously stylish, it installs in around an hour with no wiring, no hassle, and no callbacks. From ambient deck lights to dramatic spotlights, Dellaora adds instant impact to any outdoor space.

Explore the full range of Dellaora lights, from deck and ground uplights to wall lights and drive-over lights, available today with direct-to-site delivery, all backed with Talasey support and a 3-year warranty.

outdoor-kitchens.description: Coming soon! Stay tuned for updates on our latest product releases, including beautiful outdoor kitchens.

garden-storage.description: Coming soon! Stay tuned for updates on our latest product releases, including stylish yet practical garden storage solutions.

garden-rooms.description: Create the perfect outdoor retreat with Talasey’s bespoke Garden Rooms. Designed and built to your exact requirements, our custom garden rooms provide stylish, functional spaces for home offices, gyms, studios, entertainment areas, or relaxing escapes. Contact us today to discuss your bespoke garden room project.

planters.description: Create structure and focal points with our powder coated steel and corten planters. Choose from standard sizes, add small extras such as wheels or request a complete made-to-order option in your chosen finish, size, and colour to suit any residential, commercial, or urban project.
planters.closing: To take your planting to the next level, we can create bespoke planters that bring your vision to life. Handcrafted in Britain, each piece is uniquely yours, designed to suit your style, space, and planting needs.

water-features.description: Our bespoke water features can be made in various shapes, sizes and colours to suit your requirements. Contact us today for more information on our custom water features.

garden-screens.description:
With our extensive collection of premium laser-cut metal screens and wall art, finding the perfect piece might feel overwhelming. If nothing feels quite right, there are more in the collection, or simply share your vision with us, as our on-site craftsman will bring your design to life and create a bespoke piece tailored just for you.

Bring bold detail to walls, fences and pergolas or create sections and private spaces within outdoor areas, with our wall mounted and free standing decorative screens.
garden-screens.closing: Available in custom sizes, designs, logos and colours, our screens are designed to enhance fencing, façades and outdoor features. If you can imagine it, whether sketched, drawn or designed, we can cut it, bringing your vision to life with precision and style.

garden-sculptures.description: Bring any space to life with our striking metal sculptures. From recycled steel, corten steel to powder-coated steel, these pieces are designed to stand the test of time and weather beautifully with age.
garden-sculptures.closing: We hope we have inspired you with some of our Sculptures collection and if you have your own design, we can take sculpture commissions that turn your ideas into lasting works of art. Crafted in Britain from powder-coated, stainless, or corten steel, each piece is uniquely yours, designed to suit your vision and space.
